description: Source code implementing a heap memory management system for Zephyr OS, including functions for allocation, freeing, splitting, merging, and aligned memory handling.

methods.name: increase_allocated_bytes
methods.description: Increments the allocated bytes counter and updates maximum allocated bytes if necessary.

methods.name: chunk_mem
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the memory chunk given a heap and chunk ID.

methods.name: free_list_remove_bidx
methods.description: Removes a chunk from the free list at a specific bucket index.

methods.name: free_list_remove
methods.description: Removes a chunk from the free list.

methods.name: free_list_add_bidx
methods.description: Adds a chunk to the free list at a specific bucket index.

methods.name: free_list_add
methods.description: Adds a chunk to the free list.

methods.name: split_chunks
methods.description: Splits a chunk into two at a specified point, leaving both free.

methods.name: merge_chunks
methods.description: Merges two adjacent free chunks into one.

methods.name: free_chunk
methods.description: Frees a chunk, merging with adjacent free chunks if possible.

methods.name: mem_to_chunkid
methods.description: Converts a memory pointer to a chunk ID.

methods.name: sys_heap_free
methods.description: Frees allocated memory back to the heap.

methods.name: sys_heap_usable_size
methods.description: Returns the usable size of an allocated memory block.

methods.name: alloc_chunk
methods.description: Allocates a chunk of memory of a specified size.

methods.name: sys_heap_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of a given size from the heap.

methods.name: sys_heap_aligned_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory with specific alignment requirements.

methods.name: sys_heap_init
methods.description: Initializes the heap with a memory buffer.
